summary: Booba's collection of fun brain training mini-games for kids and children!
description: Have fun and stimulate your brain with little Booba! Kids can now enjoy a variety of games in one and immerse themselves in the adventures of the adorable cartoon character. Enjoy hours of entertainment and be delighted with Booba's joy by playing this collection of free mini-games. If you enjoy watching Booba videos, your favorite character is waiting for you to join the learning adventure! With this many games in one application you can have fun while stimulating cognitive skills such as memory, attention or logical reasoning. Play now the pastimes for kids, a collection of mini-games designed to test children's skills. Will you be able to solve all the levels of the different games and overcome the puzzles? BOOBA EDUCATIONAL GAMES In this compilation of booba mini-games you can enjoy a large number of children's games: *Apple Road: draw a single line for Booba to eat all the apples. *Dangerous Fire: help the leaf to collect all the water drops, avoiding touching the crazy flames. *Gift puzzle: drag and slide the pieces to place them and complete the puzzle. *Cheese maze: move the cheese through the maze until you reach Booba. *Number addition: add digits until you get the proposed number and improve your math skills. *Color the canvas: paint and color the drawing of the cute Booba characters. And many more fun games for toddlers and kids! FEATURES OF BOOBA'S GAMES FOR CHILDREN * Fast, classic and fun games * Mini-games for kids to stimulate the brain. * Different levels of difficulty * Simple and intuitive interface * Fun designs and animations * Original Booba sounds and voices * Stimulates the mind in an entertaining way * Game available for free even without internet ABOUT BOOBA Booba is a fun cartoon series for children. The world is a mystery for little Booba. This adorable and curious character who explores everything around him has become one of the favorite entertainments for children. Have fun now with Booba and stimulate your brain at the same time! ABOUT PLAYKIDS EDUJOY Thank you very much for playing Edujoy games. We love creating fun and educational games for people of all ages.
